mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.cover_image, a.category_id, c.category_name, coalesce(nullif(u.nickname, ''), u.username) as author_name, coalesce(a.read_count, 0) as read_count, a.status, a.updated_at, a.published_at
mapper.select:
select
from knowledge_article a left join knowledge_category c on c.id = a.category_id left join user u on u.id = a.author_id
and a.title like concat('%', #{title}, '%')
and a.category_id = #{categoryId}
and a.status = #{status}
order by
a.read_count a.published_at a.updated_at
asc desc
, a.id desc

select a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.cover_image, a.category_id, c.category_name, coalesce(nullif(u.nickname, ''), u.username) as author_name, coalesce(a.read_count, 0) as read_count, a.status, a.tags, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.published_at from knowledge_article a left join knowledge_category c on c.id = a.category_id left join user u on u.id = a.author_id where a.id = #{id}
